_doc: Fun-metric limits and baseline for run_bot_test.py --fun-check (see fun_report.py). First-reward, wait and rewards medians from the 8-bot, 180 s WebSocket run on 2026-11-23 (four runs: first reward 7.4-8.5 s, rewards/min 4.2-6.2, wait 0.01 s). Skills and dead time re-taken 2026-11-23 after gameplay's #98 kept bots gathering (three local runs, 8 bots x 180 s, WebSocket + Postgres): bots levelled 8/8/7, first level-up after 33.7/34.7/39.7 s of gathering (median; worst 39.8-54.0), longest dead time median 35.1/38.2/22.6 s (worst 46.8-54.4), rewards/min 9.9-10.6. bots_levelled_min is 6 so one slow CI runner doesn't flake; longest_dead_s_worst is 75 s (worst seen 54) and the median is compared against 35 s with 10 s slack. rewards_per_min baseline raised from 4.15 to 8.0 to lock in #98's gain (fails below 6.4); raise it to ~10 once CI runs confirm it.
